proof_cards.title: Marine aluminum restoration
proof_cards.result: AlumiBrite lifted oxidation and weathering from the aluminum while Torque delivered a clean, finished vessel surface.
proof_cards.narrative: Oxidation and weathering left the aluminum dull. AlumiBrite used wetting and controlled oxide removal; Torque lifted remaining film and left a polished finish, combining restoration and finish care.
proof_cards.image_alt: Aluminum vessel before the VertKlean restoration
proof_cards.image_after_alt: Brighter aluminum vessel after the VertKlean restoration

proof_cards.title: HVAC rust and scale restoration
proof_cards.result: VertKlean HCR removed stubborn rust and mineral scale from HVAC metal and diamond plate, restoring visibly cleaner surfaces without conventional acid.
proof_cards.narrative: Rust and mineral scale covered HVAC metal and diamond plate. HCR used controlled mineral-removal chemistry to release the deposits; the recorded surfaces finished visibly cleaner with one descaling method.
proof_cards.image_alt: HVAC metal and diamond plate before HCR cleaning
proof_cards.image_after_alt: HVAC metal and diamond plate after HCR cleaning

proof_cards.title: CR + HCR brewery CIP results
proof_cards.result: VertKlean CR and HCR replaced caustic and mineral acid in brewery CIP while removing organics, beer stone, rust, and scale across process equipment.
proof_cards.narrative: Organic soil and mineral beer stone required different mechanisms. CR wet and lifted organic load; HCR reacted with carbonate scale and rust, giving crews one two-step tank and heat-exchanger cycle.
proof_cards.image_alt: Brewery tank and heat exchanger cleaned with VertKlean CR and HCR

proof_cards.title: Commercial-kitchen grease removal

proof_cards.narrative: Baked-on grease loaded the working surface. CR HD used high-pH wetting, sequestration, and soil lift to break it free; the before-and-after sequence shows a visibly cleaner kitchen area.

proof_cards.title: Rust-and-scale removal

proof_cards.title: Fire-system component descaling
proof_cards.result: VertKlean Descaler cleared mineral buildup from a fire-system component without the handling burden of conventional hydrochloric acid.
proof_cards.narrative: Mineral buildup covered the component. Descaler combined wetting with a controlled mineral reaction to release the deposit; the service record shows a visibly cleaner surface after the cycle.

proof_cards.title: Property-surface restoration

proof_cards.narrative: Embedded soil, biological buildup, and grout staining marked the property surfaces. CR lifted soil while LAM3 supported longer-dwell exterior cleaning; the sequence shows visibly cleaner hardscape and grout.
